bakery style oreo stuffed cookies 🍪🥛    recipe: ingredients: ¾ cup salted butter, softened (170 g) ¾ cup packed brown sugar (150 g) ¼ cup granulated sugar (50 g) 1 large egg  1 tsp vanilla (5 g) 2 cups all-purpose flour (240 g) 1 tbsp cornstarch (8 g) ½ tsp baking soda (3 g) ¼ tsp salt (1.5 g) oreos, some whole some  roughly chopped  white chocolate (measure with your heart)  & choceur cookie and cream chocolate’s   instructions: cream the butter and sugars together  until smooth and slightly fluffy. mix in the egg and vanilla until fully combined. in a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, baking soda, and salt. fold the dry ingredients into the wet just until combined.  chop some of the oreos into small chunks ( leave some for topping ) and fold them in along with the white chocolate. scoop the dough into 8 portions, flatten and add an oreo inside and chocolate then shape into tall mounds. ( i flatten the top but keep them tall ) bake at 375°F for 11–14 minutes, until the edges are set and the centers are still soft. ( baking time may vary ) let cool to set the cookies!  i added moser roths white chocolate to the bottom & inside !    #oreo #cookies #chocolatechipcookies #Recipe #baking

‼️Du hast Sonnencreme dein ganzes Leben lang falsch benutzt! 😳☀️  Viele denken: „Ich habe Sonnencreme drauf, also kann mir nichts passieren.“ Aber so einfach ist es leider nicht. Jede Haut hat eine sogenannte Eigenschutzzeit. Das ist die Zeit, die deine Haut ungeschützt in der Sonne verbringen kann, bevor ein Sonnenbrand entsteht. Bei sehr heller Haut können das oft nur 5–10 Minuten sein, bei dunkleren Hauttypen etwas länger. Der Lichtschutzfaktor (LSF) gibt an, um wie viel diese Eigenschutzzeit theoretisch verlängert wird. Beispiel: Eigenschutzzeit 10 Minuten LSF 30 10 × 30 = 300 Minuten theoretischer Schutz Aber jetzt kommt der wichtige Haken: Diese Berechnung stammt aus Laborbedingungen. Im echten Leben schwitzen wir, gehen ins Wasser, trocknen uns ab, tragen Kleidung oder cremen viel zu wenig Sonnencreme auf. Die meisten Menschen verwenden nur etwa ein Viertel bis die Hälfte der empfohlenen Menge. Dadurch wird der tatsächliche Schutz oft deutlich geringer als auf der Verpackung angegeben. ‼️Wichtig übrigens:  Nachcremen verlängert deine maximale Sonnenzeit nicht unbegrenzt. Es sorgt lediglich dafür, dass der ursprünglich vorhandene Schutz möglichst erhalten bleibt. Sonnencreme ist außerdem kein Freifahrtschein für stundenlanges Sonnenbaden. Schatten, Kleidung, Sonnenbrille und das Meiden der Mittagssonne bleiben wichtige Bestandteile des Sonnenschutzes. 💡Fun Fact: Für den gesamten Körper eines Erwachsenen werden ungefähr 30–40 ml Sonnencreme benötigt, das entspricht etwa sechs gehäuften Teelöffeln oder einem kleinen Schnapsglas voll. Die meisten Menschen verwenden deutlich weniger. ✨Schick dieses Reel an jemanden, der denkt, mit Sonnencreme wäre man unbesiegbar. ➡️Welchen LSF nutzt du, wenn du Raus in die Sonne gehst? 매일 새벽 손으로 직접 만드는 수제만두, 젊은 사장님에게서 느껴지는 '할머니의 손맛' 📍망원 연만두  (주소: 서울 마포구 망원로 77 1층 연만두)   🔗네이버 지도: https://naver.me/5Kb3ejlY   🥟만두 한 판 8,500원 / 왕치즈군만두 1개 2,500원   📦택배 신청: 매주 월요일 오후 5시까지 문자 접수 (연락처: 010-5941- 7816)   망원시장의 소문난 만두 맛집 '연만두'. 많은 분이 연세 지긋한 할머니가 운영하실 거라 오해할 만큼 깊은 손맛을 자랑하는 곳입니다. 하지만 이곳의 주인공은 만두에 인생을 건 젊은 사장님이었는데요.  그 깊은 맛의 비결은 진심어린 정성에 있었습니다.  "기계는 재료를 뭉개버린다"는 철학 아래, 매일 새벽부터 나와 모든 재료를 일일이 손으로 버무리고 직접 빚으시더라구요. 재료 하나하나의 식감이 살아있는 꽉 찬 만두 속은 그렇게 사장님의 고집으로 완성됩니다.  워낙 정성껏 소량만 준비하기 때문에 금세 품절되기로 유명한데요. 방문 전 전화 주문이나 네이버 예약을 이용하시면 헛걸음 없이 바로 가져가실 수 있으니 꼭 참고하세요!   주문 즉시 튀겨주시는 치즈 군만두는 갓 튀겨낸 바삭한 식감 속에 고소하게 늘어나는 치즈와 만두 속의 조화가 그야말로 환상적입니다.. 정성과 맛, 어느 하나 빠지지 않는 망원동의 진정한 인생 만두를 만나보세요!   - Deep flavor hand-mixed every dawn: Finding 'Grandmother's Touch' in a Young Master 📍망원 연만두 'Yeon-Mandu' (77, Mangwon-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea)   🔗 https://maps.app.goo.gl/jDhS1Q11mVTn1mBA9   'Yeon-Mandu' is a renowned dumpling spot near Mangwon Market, famous for a deep, traditional flavor that leads many to assume an elderly grandmother must be running the shop. Surprisingly, the true master behind these dumplings is a young man who has dedicated his life to this craft.   The secret to such profound flavor lies in his sincere devotion. Following his philosophy that "machines crush the ingredients' texture," he starts his day in the early hours of the dawn, hand-mixing and folding every single dumpling. This stubborn commitment is what creates the perfect filling, where the texture of each ingredient remains intact and vibrant.   Because each dumpling is made with such meticulous care in limited quantities, they are famous for selling out quickly. We highly recommend placing a phone order or using Naver Reservation before your visit to ensure you don't miss out!  Don't miss the Cheese Fried Dumplings, fried to order for a perfectly crispy texture. The harmony of the savory, melting cheese and the rich dumpling filling is simply heavenly. Ooey-Gooey Scoopable Nutella Cookie Pie🤤 Yields: 15-16 Chunky Cookies INGREDIENTS:  230g Cold Chopped Unsalted Butter  160g Caster Sugar  160g Light Brown Sugar  450g Chocolate Chunks or chips  475g Plain Flour  1 tsp Salt 3 tsp Baking Powder  3/4 tsp Baking Soda  2 Eggs  1 Egg Yolk  1 tsp Vanilla  INSTRUCTIONS: •Cut cling wrap into small squares. Scoop ½ teaspoon Nutella onto individual cling-wrap squares. Fold to seal and freeze until solid. (Repeat for however many Nutella stuffed cookies you plan to make.) •In a large mixing bowl, add the cold cubed butter and whisk until slightly creamy. Add the white sugar and light brown sugar, then whisk together until well combined and fluffy. •Add the eggs, vanilla extract, and chocolate chips or chunks. Whisk until fully incorporated. •Add the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Gently mix until just combined, do not overmix. •Portion the dough into 90g balls. Press a frozen Nutella piece into the centre of each dough ball, seal well, and roll into a smooth ball. •Place the stuffed cookie dough balls onto a tray and freeze for at least 30 minutes (or overnight for best results). •Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F). •Take any shape baking dish circle, square, rectangle anything and line it with parchment paper. Arrange frozen cookie dough balls in it leaving some space between them. •Bake for 10-15 minutes (timing depends on the type of pan) or until the tops are lightly golden while the centres remain soft and gooey. •Remove from the oven and let cool slightly. •Serve warm with ice cream and chocolate sauce enjoy!✨ NOTE: Store any extra dough balls in an airtight container or freezer bag and freeze for later. Whenever a cookie craving hits, bake straight from frozen🫶🏻 #cookie #nutella #cookiepie #fyp #viral

Çikolatalı Kruvasan Poğaça | Easy Chocolate Croissants 🥐🍫 English ⬇️ Yumuşacık, pofuduk ve bol çikolatalı✨ Hamuru İçin; * 1 su bardağı ılık süt (200 ml) * 1 su bardağı ılık su (200 ml) * 1 çay bardağı sıvı yağ (125 ml) * 1 adet yumurta akı * 1 paket instant maya * 2 çay kaşığı toz şeker * 2 çay kaşığı tuz * 4,5–5 su bardağı un * 2 yemek kaşığı kakao Arası İçin * Sürülebilir çikolata veya çikolata parçaları Üzeri İçin * 1 adet yumurta sarısı * Pudra şekeri Hazırlanışı;  •Bütün malzemeleri alıp hamuru yoğurun. Daha sonra hamuru ikiye ayırın. Yarısına kakao ekleyip her iki hamuru da 40 dakika mayalandırın.  •Sade hamuru açıp ortasına kakaolu hamuru yerleştirin ve kapatın. Tek parça halinde tekrar açıp üçgenlere kesin. Geniş kısımlarına çikolata koyup kruvasan şeklinde sarın.  •Tepside 30 dakika mayalandırdıktan sonra üzerlerine yumurta sarısı sürün. 180 derecede yaklaşık 30 dakika pişirin. Soğuyunca pudra şekeri serperek servis edin. 🍫🥐 English ⬇️ For the Dough: * 1 cup warm milk (200 ml) * 1 cup warm water (200 ml) * ½ cup vegetable oil (125 ml) * 1 egg white * 10g instant yeast * 2 tsp sugar * 2 tsp salt * 4½–5 cups all-purpose flour * 2 tbsp cocoa powder For the Filling: * Chocolate spread or chocolate pieces For the Topping: * 1 egg yolk * Powdered sugar Instructions: • Combine all the dough ingredients and knead until you have a soft dough. Divide the dough into two equal parts. Add the cocoa powder to one half and knead until fully incorporated. Let both doughs rise for 40 minutes. • Roll out the plain dough and place the cocoa dough in the center. Fold and seal the plain dough around it. Roll it out again into a large circle and cut into triangles. Place chocolate on the wide end of each triangle and roll up into croissant shapes. • Let them proof on the baking tray for 30 minutes. Brush with egg yolk and bake at 180°C (350°F) for about 30 minutes, or until golden brown. • Once cooled, dust with powdered sugar and serve. 🍫🥐✨ #busezeynep #croissant

Raising Cane’s-Style Chicken Fingers With Cane’s Sauce. Ingredients: For the Chicken: - 2 lb chicken breast, cut into strips - Oil for frying For the Wet Batter: - 2 cups buttermilk - 2 tbsp garlic powder - 1 tbsp black pepper - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp smoked paprika For the Dry Batter: - 2 cups all-purpose flour - 3 tbsp cornstarch - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp garlic powder - 1 tsp black pepper - 1 tsp smoked paprika For the Cane’s Sauce: - 1 cup mayonnaise - 4 tbsp ketchup - 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce - 1 tbsp garlic powder - 1 tsp black pepper - Salt to taste - 1 tsp smoked paprika Instructions: 1. Prepare the wet batter by whisking together buttermilk, garlic powder, black pepper, salt, and smoked paprika. Add the chicken strips to the wet batter and marinate for at least 2 hours or overnight. 2. Prepare the dry batter by whisking together flour, cornstarch, salt, garlic powder, black pepper, and smoked paprika. 3. Remove the chicken from the wet batter, allowing excess to drip off, then coat each strip in the dry batter. 4. Deep-fry the coated chicken strips in hot oil (about 350°F) until golden brown and cooked through, approximately 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway through. 5. Prepare the Cane’s Sauce by whisking together mayonnaise, ketchup,Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, black pepper, salt, and smoked paprika. 6. Serve the crispy chicken fingers with Cane’s Sauce. #canessauce #raisingcanes #friedchicken #chickentenders #Recipe
